d: Long, flowing ash-grey hair with straight bangs and a side-parted style, paired with wide, expressive golden-brown eyes. Appearing as a mature adolescent, the figure has a curvaceous build. The outfit consists of a vibrant red military-style jacket with gold braided fastenings and a matching red beret, layered over a black lace bodice and a white bow with a blue ribbon. Signature details include a gold chain draped across the chest, a planet-themed patch on the shoulder, and a small red bow on the beret.
